formulations.Polymer system Notes: High-purity high-MW PEO (HP-PEO), made with an anionic initiator (about 1 ppm initiator); lower polydispersity than commercial PEO and no detectable low-MW fraction. Complexed with LiClO4.
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Text: for C-PEO and HP-PEO LiClO4 amorphous electrolytes, the apparent Ea falls from 1 eV to 0.26 eV as the salt weight fraction drops from 0.25 to 0.02 (Fig. 4, T = 65 °C, amorphous single phase above 65 °C). The ~1 eV value is for weight fraction 0.25.
formulations.drying temp: 45-50 (polymer dried before use); LiClO4 dried at 100-110
formulations.Notes: Salt weight fraction 0.25. The paper says MW ≈ 1×10^6 without saying which average. Electrolytes with weight fraction < 0.28 (O/Li > 6) are amorphous single phase above 65 °C. Conductivities at 85/125 °C appear only in Fig. 3 (digitised values are unreliable), so they are not reported. Measured by AC impedance on the first temperature rise, 60-120 °C.
formulations.Reference: D. Fauteux, J. Prud'homme, P.E. Harvey, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 923-928

formulations.Polymer system Notes: High-purity high-MW PEO (HP-PEO). Complexed with LiCF3SO3 in the two-phase (crystalline-amorphous) domain.
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Text: across the two-phase domain the apparent Ea is constant at 0.7 eV for both C-PEO and HP-PEO LiCF3SO3 (Fig. 2, T = 65 °C). More dilute single-phase amorphous compositions (above 65 °C) have a lower Ea that depends on concentration; those values are only in Fig. 2 and are not reported.
formulations.drying temp: 45-50 (polymer dried before use); LiCF3SO3 dried at 100-110
formulations.Notes: This record stands for the whole two-phase composition range, not one exact concentration; the stability section places the two-phase domain at about 0.18 < x < 0.45 (salt weight fraction, at 105 °C). O/Li values studied ranged from 4 to 100. Conductivity isotherms at 85/125 °C are only in Fig. 1 (the digitised values look implausible, e.g. 1e-4 S/cm with no salt), so they are not reported. HP-PEO electrolytes are slightly less crystalline than C-PEO ones. Diffusion-limited current at 70 °C is about 0.5 mA/cm2.
formulations.Reference: D. Fauteux, J. Prud'homme, P.E. Harvey, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 923-928

formulations.Notes: This record stands for the whole two-phase composition range (about 0.18 < x < 0.45 salt weight fraction), not one exact concentration.
